लोललाङ्गूल Hanumatstotra, from the Rudrayāmala. Oudh
XIV, 100.

लोलिम्बराज son of Divākara, client of Harihara, son
of Sūrya:
 Camatkāracintāmaṇi med.
 Ratnakalācaritra med.
 Vaidyajīvana.
 Vaidyavilāsa (?).

. See Harivilāsa.
 Vaidyāvataṃsa.
 Harivilāsa kāvya.
 Lolimbarājīya med. Oppert II, 3316.

लोल्लट a writer on music. Mentioned in Saṃgītaratnā-
kara, Catal. IO. p. 316.
